latHint: Think giving up a bad habit for good - not falling from a cliff.
pivHint: A cliff DROP is a steep fall - but to DROP a bad habit means to do what?
winText: Letting go for good. DROP was the pivot - a steep fall to DITCHing a habit.
lossText: DITCH - to DROP for good. DROP was the pivot: cliff's edge to DITCHing a habit.
